from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from refproj.inventory import StockItem, transfer

BACK_ROOM = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=7)
SHOP_FLOOR = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.75"), on_hand=2)
OTHER_ARTICLE = StockItem(sku="G-9", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=2)


def test_source_has_quantity_units_fewer() -> None:
    source, _ = transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, 3)
    assert source.on_hand == 4


def test_target_has_quantity_units_more() -> None:
    _, target = transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, 3)
    assert target.on_hand == 5


def test_skus_are_unchanged() -> None:
    source, target = transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, 3)
    assert (source.sku, target.sku) == ("W-1", "W-1")


def test_unit_prices_are_unchanged() -> None:
    source, target = transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, 3)
    assert (source.unit_price, target.unit_price) == (Decimal("2.50"), Decimal("2.75"))


def test_arguments_are_untouched() -> None:
    source = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=7)
    target = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.75"), on_hand=2)
    transfer(source, target, 3)
    assert source == StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=7)
    assert target == StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.75"), on_hand=2)


def test_whole_shelf_can_be_moved() -> None:
    source, target = transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, 7)
    assert (source.on_hand, target.on_hand) == (0, 9)


def test_nothing_is_lost_or_made() -> None:
    before = BACK_ROOM.on_hand + SHOP_FLOOR.on_hand
    source, target = transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, 3)
    assert before == 9
    assert source.on_hand + target.on_hand == 9


def test_cannot_transfer_between_different_skus() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different SKUs"):
        transfer(BACK_ROOM, OTHER_ARTICLE, 3)


def test_cannot_transfer_zero() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="quantity must be positive"):
        transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, 0)


def test_cannot_transfer_a_negative_quantity() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="quantity must be positive"):
        transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, -1)


def test_cannot_transfer_more_than_on_hand() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="only"):
        transfer(BACK_ROOM, SHOP_FLOOR, 8)


def test_different_skus_reported_before_non_positive_quantity() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different SKUs"):
        transfer(BACK_ROOM, OTHER_ARTICLE, 0)


def test_different_skus_reported_before_shortage() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different SKUs"):
        transfer(BACK_ROOM, OTHER_ARTICLE, 8)


def test_non_positive_quantity_reported_before_shortage() -> None:
    # The only way both apply: a shelf already in deficit, asked for a smaller negative.
    in_deficit = StockItem(sku="W-1", unit_price=Decimal("2.50"), on_hand=-5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="quantity must be positive"):
        transfer(in_deficit, SHOP_FLOOR, -1)
